text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 你好，欢迎收听《简易英语》
zh_hant: 你好，歡迎收聽《簡易英語》

text: the podcast where we have real conversations.
zh: 这是一个我们进行真实对话的播客，
zh_hant: 這是一個我們進行真實對話的播客，

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 用简单的英语来帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 用簡單的英語來幫助你學習。

text: I'm Beth.
And I'm Neil.
There is a video version of this podcast on our website,
zh: 这个播客在我们的网站上有视频版本，
zh_hant: 這個播客在我們的網站上有影片版本，

text: where you can also find a worksheet and transcript to help you learn.
zh: 你还可以在那里找到工作表和学习记录来帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 你還可以在那裡找到工作表和學習記錄來幫助你學習。

text: It's at bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi, Neil, how are you?
I'm hungry.
Me too.
I'm starving.
Well, that's good, because we're talking about lunch today.
zh: 嗯，那正好，因为我们今天要聊午餐。
zh_hant: 嗯，那正好，因為我們今天要聊午餐。

text: We're recording this just before lunch,
zh: 我们是在午饭前录的这段，
zh_hant: 我們是在午飯前錄的這段，

text: so it's no wonder that we're both very hungry.
zh: 所以难怪我们俩都很饿。
zh_hant: 所以難怪我們倆都很餓。

text: You might be able to hear our tummies rumble because we're hungry.
zh: 你可能会听到我们的肚子咕咕叫，因为我们饿了。
zh_hant: 你可能會聽到我們的肚子咕咕叫，因為我們餓了。

text: OK.
So, shall we begin?
Yes.
Let's do it.
What have you got for lunch today?
for my lunch,
I have chicken with potatoes
and vegetables in a harissa paste.
Oh, that sounds really nice.
Yeah, it's leftovers actually,
which I have heated up and brought in in a little flask.
zh: 我加热了放在小保温瓶里带来的。
zh_hant: 我加熱了放在小保溫瓶裡帶來的。

text: What are leftovers?
Good question.
That's food from a meal that you've already
had that you didn't finish,
and you can heat it up and eat it again.
zh: 你可以加热后再吃一顿。
zh_hant: 你可以加熱後再吃一頓。

text: Yes.
I also have leftovers for my lunch today.
So, yesterday I made a pasta
zh: 昨天我做了一顿意大利面
zh_hant: 昨天我做了一頓義大利麵

text: for lunch with vegetables in it
and I have that.
So, Beth, what do you usually have for lunch?
zh: 贝丝，你平时午餐通常吃什么？
zh_hant: 貝絲，你平時午餐通常吃什麼？

text: Is it usually leftovers or something else?
zh: 是通常吃剩饭还是别的？
zh_hant: 是通常吃剩飯還是別的？

text: It's usually leftovers when I come into work
zh: 我上班的时候通常是吃剩饭，
zh_hant: 我上班的時候通常是吃剩飯，

text: because it's easier,
and then I don't need to buy lunch.
But if I go out and buy food,
then I would usually go for something like
sushi or ramen.
What about you?
What do you usually have for lunch?
Yeah.
Sometimes I have leftovers that I bring in.
Sometimes, I buy a sandwich, for example.
zh: 有时我会买个三明治什么的。
zh_hant: 有時我會買個三明治什麼的。

text: What's your favourite kind of sandwich?
If I have a sandwich, if I buy a sandwich for lunch,
zh: 如果我买三明治当午餐，
zh_hant: 如果我買三明治當午餐，

text: I like to get things like smoked salmon.
zh: 我喜欢选烟熏三文鱼之类的。
zh_hant: 我喜歡選煙燻三文魚之類的。

text: Nice.
With pickles maybe, yeah.
There's a really good baguette I like actually
zh: 其实我喜欢一家很好吃的法棍三明治，
zh_hant: 其實我喜歡一家很好吃的法棍三明治，

text: that has smoked salmon
and egg mayonnaise in it.
Oh, it's so nice.
Stop it.
Sorry.
I'm so hungry.
Me too.
Neil, do you ever skip lunch?
zh: 尼尔，你跳过午饭不吃吗？
zh_hant: 尼爾，你跳過午飯不吃嗎？

text: No way.
I would be in a horrible mood if I skipped lunch.
zh: 我要是不吃午饭，脾气会很糟糕。
zh_hant: 我要是不吃午飯，脾氣會很糟糕。

text: I don't understand how anyone can skip any meal.
zh: 我不明白怎么会有人能漏掉任何一顿饭。
zh_hant: 我不明白怎麼會有人能漏掉任何一頓飯。

text: I need to eat all my meals.
Yeah.
Otherwise, you get hangry.
Exactly.
'Hangry' is hungry and angry.
I'm on the…
I'm almost getting hangry now.
What's your favourite meal?
Is it lunch?
Breakfast?
Dinner?
I think the evening meal is probably my favourite because we
zh: 我觉得晚餐可能是我最喜欢的，因为我们
zh_hant: 我覺得晚餐可能是我最喜歡的，因為我們

text: sit at the table and chat and it's the biggest,
zh: 坐在餐桌旁聊天，而且那是一天中最大、
zh_hant: 坐在餐桌旁聊天，而且那是一天中最大、

text: nicest meal of the day
and you don't really have to do anything after so you can relax.
zh: 之后也不用做什么事情，可以放松一下。
zh_hant: 之後也不用做什麼事情，可以放鬆一下。

text: Yeah that's good.
I really like brunch which is that sort of in between breakfast and lunch,
zh: 我特别喜欢早午餐，就是那种在早餐和午餐之间的饭，
zh_hant: 我特別喜歡早午餐，就是那種在早餐和午餐之間的飯，

text: maybe 10:00.
And I might have eggs
and bacon and hash browns and avocado,
a big meal full of lots of good food, like a brunch.
zh: 一顿丰盛的美食大餐，就像早午餐那样。
zh_hant: 一頓豐盛的美食大餐，就像早午餐那樣。

text: Do you ever have a working lunch?
I do occasionally if I'm working from home
because I can carry on working and eat quickly.
zh: 因为我可以边工作边快速吃饭。
zh_hant: 因為我可以邊工作邊快速吃飯。

text: And then in my actual lunch break,
zh: 然后在真正的午休时间里，
zh_hant: 然後在真正的午休時間裡，

text: I might have a nice long walk or something like that,
zh: 我可能会出去好好散个步什么的，
zh_hant: 我可能會出去好好散個步什麼的，

text: but when I'm in the office, I don't want to eat at my desk.
zh: 但在办公室时，我一点都不想在办公桌前吃饭。
zh_hant: 但在辦公室時，我一點都不想在辦公桌前吃飯。

text: No.
Me neither.
I don't really like working lunches.
I would rather eat my lunch without working.
zh: 我宁愿不工作，好好吃午餐。
zh_hant: 我寧願不工作，好好吃午餐。

text: Yeah, I'd prefer the same, really.
We heard 'working
lunch',
which is when you eat your lunch while you're working.
zh: 就是一边工作一边吃饭。
zh_hant: 就是一邊工作一邊吃飯。

text: We also had 'leftovers', which is when you don't finish a meal,
zh: 我们还学了“剩饭”，就是一顿饭没吃完，
zh_hant: 我們還學了“剩飯”，就是一頓飯沒吃完，

text: so you have more of it at a different time, like the next day.
zh: 然后在其他时间再吃剩下的，比如第二天。
zh_hant: 然後在其他時間再吃剩下的，比如第二天。

text: And we talked about which meals and food we prefer.
zh: 我们还聊了我们更喜欢哪些餐和食物。
zh_hant: 我們還聊了我們更喜歡哪些餐和食物。

text: If you prefer something, you like it better than something else.
zh: 如果你偏好某样东西，就是比起别的你更喜欢它。
zh_hant: 如果你偏好某樣東西，就是比起別的你更喜歡它。

text: Yes.
And another phrase we can use to say this is 'would rather'.
zh: 表达这个意思的另一个短语是“would rather”。
zh_hant: 表達這個意思的另一個短語是“would rather”。

text: For example, I 'd rather have sushi than a sandwich for lunch.
zh: 比如，午餐我宁愿吃寿司而不是三明治。
zh_hant: 比如，午餐我寧願吃壽司而不是三明治。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期《简易英语》的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期《簡易英語》的全部內容。

text: Test what you've learned with a worksheet on our website,
zh: 用我们网站上的工作表测试你学到的内容，
zh_hant: 用我們網站上的工作表測試你學到的內容，

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
And make sure you join us again for another easy English conversation.
zh: 一定要再来参加我们的另一场简易英语对话。
zh_hant: 一定要再來參加我們的另一場簡易英語對話。

text: We'll be back next week.
See you soon.
Goodbye.
